result.Method of Attack: Unauthenticated access to exposed GraphQL server allowing arbitrary fault injections and OS command injection leading to remote code execution and cluster takeover
result.Attack Vector: In-cluster network access to Chaos Controller Manager's exposed GraphQL server with no authentication
result.Indicators of Compromise: Exposed port 10082 on chaos-controller-manager pod; ability to run GraphQL mutations such as killProcesses, cleanTcs, cleanIptables with injected OS commands
